newsitem.title: POLAND: PBR wants to buy 10 pct of PBK bank.
newsitem.headline: PBR wants to buy 10 pct of PBK bank.

text.p: The Polish Development Bank (PBR), leader of a group bidding for a controlling stake of state-owned Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK), wants to own 10 percent of the bank, PBR's president said on Tuesday.
"Our aim is to own 10 percent of PBK shares so as, among other reasons, to have one place in PBK's supervisory board," Mieczyslaw Groszek told a news conference.
PBR leads a consortium bidding jointly for at least 51 percent of PBK, which also includes Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA (BPH), Kredyt Bank SA and insurer TUiR Warta.
Groszek said the firms in the group could, after the purchase, swap shares among one another. He gave no further details.

The treasury ministry, offering between 10 and 65 percent of PBK and planning to float another 15 percent, has said it was likely to choose the investor in the bank, estimated to be worth between 1.2 and 1.6 billion zlotys, by June 12.
Banking sources have said South Korea's Samsung was also bidding for a PBK stake.
